name: Woodworking
description: Woodworking word search puzzles gather shop and joinery English for adults and seniors — chisel, plane, grain, dovetail, clamp and calm bench words — without tool brands or licensed workshop names. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays practical and unhurried: maple, cherry, kerf, mortise, finish and edge vocabulary many lifelong makers already know. This hub pairs well with Tools and Pottery when you want a longer craft session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a squared board.
